hypothesis: The original model has useful label ranking but heterogeneous label score scales; cross-fitted label-wise calibration can recover Macro-F1 while preserving precision.
input: epoch-0 original-checkpoint probabilities on the locked 180-row internal Dev
perLabelRule: On the other four folds, require at least 4 positives; maximize label F1 among thresholds with label precision >=0.50; tie chooses higher threshold; otherwise use 0.35.
application: Convert each label score by a logit bias so its learned threshold maps to 0.35, then use the unchanged max-two selector at 0.35.
success: OOF 18-label Macro-F1 exceeds the uncalibrated OOF result and OOF Micro precision is >=0.50.
finalConfig: Per-label median of five fold-selected thresholds; exploratory development candidate only.
bounds: One grid, one rule, no external evaluation, no per-label manual edits
